Key observations from test image:
- Green stems with mature/dried brown-tan pods
- Stem remains visibly green while pods are fully dried/brown
- No leaves visible, only stem and pods
- This pattern strongly suggests **Green_stem_disorder** (green stem retention while pods are dry)

Let me check reference images to confirm.

The Green_stem_disorder reference is a near-perfect match — the top-right panel shows green stems with dried brown pods on dark soil, exactly matching the test image. The hallmark is the stem remaining green while pods are fully matured and dried.

Diaporthe shows brown/decayed stems with black specks — not matching.

Soybean Dwarf Mosaic Virus shows green, wrinkled/distorted leaves — completely different from the test image.

The test image is definitively **Green_stem_disorder**: green stems remaining at maturity while pods are fully dried and brown, exactly matching the reference collage (especially top-right panel).
